d: On the third day of Chhath Puja, devotees offer Sandhya Argha to the setting Sun God. This auspicious day begins with the preparation of thekua, a fried biscuit-like snack made of wheat flour, sugar and ghee, by the fasting members of the family. This process is laborious as the thekua needs to be fried on a low flame to ensure it is well-cooked. The ladies of the house wake up before dawn, clean the house, take a bath and then start with the preparation. They begin by kneading the dough with the flour that was milled the previous day. It's no wonder that this process entails a lot of time.
